property_summary: Invariant: the current owner can successfully call transferOwnership(newOwner) (call returns/does not revert) for any newOwner != zero; the mutant inverts onlyOwner causing the owner call to revert for at least some inputs, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Invert onlyOwner check so the function reverts unless caller is NOT the owner, preventing owner from calling transferOwnership.
